'''Thom Steele''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Biography==
Steele was responsible for CEC's [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] business. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] one of the company's mining [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Flash Harrison]], who was working on a mining project in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] got stuck on the [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Wookiee world]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] impounded his [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Harrison paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver the news to Steele on Talus. The spacer found him in the [[Dearic Cantina]].

Steele now needed a quick replacement for Harrison to aid him with several problems in the space mining business. The spacer seemed to be an able pilot, so Steele hired the adventurer on the spot. His first task for the new pilot was to patrol the [[Corellian Mining Route 42]] and attack any rival mining vessel. Steele rewarded the pilot with 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a used mining laser. After the mining laser was installed in the pilot's ship, Steele sent the pilot to retrieve a mineral sample from silicaceous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that had recently entered the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. It didn't take long before the pilot returned with the samples. Steele paid the pilot 2000 credits and then sent him to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Koh (Twi'lek)|Koh]] back on Kashyyyk to take over some of Harrison's duties.

==Behind the scenes==
Thom Steele is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second addon to [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He can be found in the Dearic Cantina in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]]. Steele is part of a questline that starts with Flash Harrison and introduces the player to [[:w:c:swg:Space mining|space mining]], a new feature of ''Rage of the Wookiees''.
